project: Wuxia Life P60 Farm Peasant Bridge Design-First Wave
description: Resolve the real bridge-direction ambiguity for farm_peasant by running a bounded design-first stage that audits existing seeds, compares candidate bridge directions, chooses one repo-grounded downstream target, and produces an implementation-ready contract for a later playable stage, without changing runtime behavior or expanding into migration, economy, or full ordinary-system work.

userStories.title: Audit farm-peasant bridge gap
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a grounded audit of farm_peasant so the next stage solves the real absence of bridge seeds instead of patching symptoms.
acceptanceCriteria: Summarize current farm_peasant early-life and midlife flags, choices, expression, and downstream wiring evidence
Identify which usable signals already exist and which bridge seeds are still missing
Explain why the apprentice bridge pattern from P58 cannot be reused directly
Save docs/test-reports/p60-farm-peasant-bridge-gap-audit.md
userStories.notes: Gap audit covers early/midlife flags, expression, profile surface, downstream wiring; identifies missing bridge seed/commitment flags/post-bridge expression; explains why apprentice pattern can't be reused (narrative fit + system fit + identity collapse risk)

userStories.title: Lock P60 scope contract
userStories.description: As a planner, I want a scope contract so P60 remains a design-first stage instead of sliding into implementation work.
acceptanceCriteria: State that P60 only covers audit, design, contract, and feasibility work
Define allowed layers: candidate-direction analysis, seed design, target selection, validation-shape planning
List forbidden expansions: runtime config changes, playable bridge proof, and broad content expansion
Save docs/test-reports/p60-farm-peasant-bridge-scope-contract.md
userStories.notes: Scope contract defines 5 allowed layers (audit, candidate analysis, seed design, target selection, validation planning) and 6 forbidden expansions (runtime config, playable proof, broad content, full ordinary redesign, economy/migration/platform, sample-line track); includes boundary guards and deliverables inventory

userStories.title: Define candidate farm-peasant bridge seeds
userStories.description: As a designer, I want candidate bridge seeds for farm_peasant so downstream implementation has a clear starting point.
acceptanceCriteria: Define at least two candidate bridge-seed directions
Bind each candidate to existing repo events, flags, or expression assets rather than free-form invention
Compare candidate narrative fit, system fit, and scope cost
Recommend one primary direction
userStories.notes: Two candidates: (A) Grain-Merchant Adjacent → merchant_magnate via P55 chain; (B) Escort-Jianghu Renown → jianghu_renown_sage. Both anchored in peasant_swap_crew_curiosity + existing assets. Full comparison matrix across 8 dimensions. Recommended: Candidate A (grain-merchant)

userStories.title: Choose and justify the downstream target
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want P60 to choose one downstream target for farm_peasant and justify it with repo evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Choose one downstream target from merchant-adjacent, renown-adjacent, or another existing mixed destiny
Explain why the chosen target is better than forcing merchant_magnate
If a new event seed is required, define it as a minimal content addition rather than a new system
Record the decision in the PRD or a linked contract document
userStories.notes: Chosen target: merchant-adjacent (merchant_magnate via P55 magnate chain). Justified over jianghu_renown because renown has no sample-line event chain (scope would explode). Distinguished from 'hard-wiring merchant_magnate' by: peasant-specific bridge flag, grain-trade framing, peasant-flavored expression, identity preservation. New seed = minimal content reframing, not new system. Decision recorded in bridge contract doc

userStories.title: Produce farm-peasant bridge contract
userStories.description: As a designer, I want a bridge contract that defines the minimum future implementation shape for farm_peasant.
acceptanceCriteria: Define the minimal prerequisite group for the chosen direction
Define where the bridge checkpoint should occur
Define the minimal new event, choice, or flag additions allowed in the future implementation stage
Define the downstream gate and expected expression change after the bridge
userStories.notes: Bridge contract defines: 4-step prerequisite chain (origin + swap_crew_curiosity + outside_offer + accept_outside); checkpoint at accept_offer choice with peasant_merchant_bridge_crossed + route_wealth_committed flags; minimal additions (0 new events, 2 new flags, 3 expression branches); downstream gates (magnate_on_ramp + merchant_midlife_debt) and identity-preserving expression changes

userStories.title: Define P61 validation shape
userStories.description: As a planner, I want a validation shape for the follow-up playable stage so P61 can stay bounded.
acceptanceCriteria: Define which proof, test, and closure artifacts P61 must produce
State which validations are required and which are intentionally deferred
Define the success criteria for the future playable bridge stage
Record the validation shape in a handoff-ready document section
userStories.notes: P61 validation shape defined in bridge contract §6: 7 required artifacts (targeted proof, ~12-15 tests, typecheck, P56/P58/P59 regression, closure report); test coverage matrix with 12 categories; 6 required vs 6 deferred validations; 6 success criteria; P61 boundary reminder

userStories.title: Produce P60 design closure report
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a closure report summarizing the chosen farm_peasant bridge direction and the exact handoff into P61.
acceptanceCriteria: Save docs/test-reports/p60-farm-peasant-bridge-design-closure-report.md
Summarize the audit, candidate comparison, final recommendation, and P61 handoff
Explain why P60 stops at design-first output rather than playable implementation
List larger ordinary, economy, or migration items that remain deferred
userStories.notes: Closure report covers: executive summary, deliverables inventory (5 docs, 0 code changes), audit summary, candidate comparison, chosen bridge summary, why P60 is design-only (direction ambiguity gap, design-first reduces risk, peasant feasibility was Low), 9 deferred items, P61 handoff, P60 self-validation (all 7 criteria met)
